title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: AC18 says an unrecognized enablement value “still publishes” a review, and AC19 makes the same unconditional promise for an invalid category list, but AC2 requires draft-skipped or superseded passes to publish no review. State that both fallbacks preserve the existing publication eligibility and publish only when the ordinary flow would; otherwise implementation requires choosing between contradictory acceptance criteria.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 3a61a49, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
